known_issues: 2BR stacks (904/969 sqft) only appear on floors 01-10 in URA prints; 1,195 sqft only on 16-25 — floor and layout are partly confounded in any size-band comp.
1,119 sqft is the one 3BR size printed on every floor tier 01-25; its 01-05 prints clear ~13-15% below its 11+ prints ($1,027-1,072 vs $1,179-1,237 psf, 2024-26).
1,152 sqft has printed only at floors 01-05 (2/2) — likely a ground/PES format; do not comp it against tower 3BRs.
